title: LBMR: Prevent GCC maybe-uninitialized warning
description:
Certain versions of GCC, with certain optimization, manage to optimize
into a bogus maybe-uninitialized warning because pattern_type is retrieved
in a different set of if branches than when it's used. Use
proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint instead.

Also use proto_tree_add_item_ret_string where we can to reduce string
copying, and make null terminated strings FT_STRINGZ instead of FT_STRING.
Fix the offset of the pattern when wildcarded.
